title: Bond Voyage! Organic Reactions
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: Practice CHEM 3B organic reactions six ways: Identify the Reaction, Pick the Product (multiple-choice warm-up with drawn structures and mistake-specific feedback, e.g. over-oxidation, anti-Markovnikov, swapped ester halves, acid vs base hydrolysis), Draw the Product, Draw the Reactant, Name It, and Full Reaction (reactant, reaction type, product, then name). Students draw on a built-in pad with automatic hydrogens and a lasso tool, and can switch between skeletal, condensed, expanded, or mixed structures. Covers alkanes and alkenes; alcohols, aldehydes, and ketones; and carboxylic acids, esters, amines, and amides. Naming accepts common alternate names. Includes a pop-out reaction reference, hints, answer reveals, XP, streaks, medal badges, and a Dr. Dan video matched to each question. Exam Practice: 157 final-exam style multiple-choice reaction questions from Final Boss, with drawn structures and reagent arrows, a topic filter, hints and explanations.
